dedupe_keys.name: discharge simulations for the seine river catchment the influence of the calibration strategy for projections with a semi distributed model

description: The STARS4Water project deposits GRSD hydrological-model outputs used to examine how calibration choices affect projected Seine discharge. The public Zenodo page says the semi-distributed model includes a reservoir module and covers 155 stations, of which 17 lie downstream of reservoirs. It describes historical and climate-scenario runs for all stations. Historical reservoir management uses observed operating information, while the projected period follows a theoretical target curve. The 55 MB ZIP is public under CC BY 4.0. These simulated flows could help a modeller compare calibration sensitivity or test a reservoir-operation scenario against an independent published ensemble. They are model outputs, not measured discharges at every station. The page does not give a file-level manifest, time step, full scenario names or spatial identifier mapping. No ZIP was opened, so units and numerical completeness remain unverified. A related Seine low-flow deposit varies reservoir management, while this one concerns calibration strategy.
